# Vixsthetics

> Vixsthetics is a medical aesthetics practice at 1149 Merrick Ave Ste 17, Merrick, NY 11566, phone (631) 408-8376. Victoria Yunaev, a physician assistant, performs every treatment: neurotoxin (Jeuveau, Xeomin, Daxxify), fillers from the RHA and Restylane collections, under eye treatment, and biostimulators (Sculptra, Radiesse), plus microneedling, IV therapy, weight loss management, and hair restoration. Dr. Peggy Bastien is the medical director. Medical services are provided by Bastien Medical PLLC.

The practice serves Merrick, North Merrick, and the South Shore of Long Island, NY. Prices are printed openly; neurotoxin is $11 per unit and dermal filler is $650 per syringe.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://vixsthetics.com/): Overview of the practice, the two signature services (full face neurotoxin treatment and lip filler), and quick answers.
- [Treatments](https://vixsthetics.com/treatments/): Every treatment in five groups with prices from the booking menu.
- [Pricing and financing](https://vixsthetics.com/pricing/): The full price list and how pricing works.
- [About the practice](https://vixsthetics.com/about/): The story, approach, and setting.
- [Victoria Yunaev, PA](https://vixsthetics.com/victoria-yunaev/): The injector, author, and reviewer of the site.
- [Medical oversight](https://vixsthetics.com/medical-oversight/): Dr. Peggy Bastien, medical director and supervising physician.
- [Results](https://vixsthetics.com/results/): Before and after images by treatment.
- [Contact and directions](https://vixsthetics.com/contact/): Address, phone, map, and question form.
- [Book a consultation](https://vixsthetics.com/book/): What happens at the 25 minute consultation and how to book.
